note: The sourcing layer — WHO each corpus source was written for, and which of our brand/avatar pairs may draw on it. Copy inherits its audience from where it was sourced: a swipe aimed at a 54-year-old woman never feeds copy aimed at a 15-year-old. `market` is evidenced from the source itself; `fits` is a RULING — only Damon fills it, and an empty fits list means the source is quarantined from injection until he does.

<competitor>.market: women 45+, aging skin — foundation/serum angles ('at 52', collagen, jowls, wrinkles)
teens / young adults, acne — 'teen hormonal acne', 'understand your acne type'
older men, aging face and neck — 'best-selling men's face treatment in Italy', 'old man', 'masculine neck definition'; Italian-origin brand, roughly half the angles in Italian

damon-saves.market: mixed — saved for market-opportunity / viral / novel-format signal, not one audience; per-row avatar_fit and bucket tags carry what is known

video-teardowns.market: per-run — each run's audience stage names the avatar and funnel it was torn down for; rows carry that verdict
